description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a fintech product engineering team building consumer financial tools that help people manage cash flow and build credit. You will own backend features end to end and contribute directly to a seamless user experience.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build product features across domain models, business logic, and API integrations.

 - Deliver and iterate on incremental releases informed by product and system data.

 - Use SQL and analytics tools to evaluate product and system performance.

 - Debug complex state machines in event-driven systems and message-driven workflows.

 - Ship production code through CI/CD, own implementations end to end, and respond to incidents as needed.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building backend features end to end for production systems, including meaningful early-stage startup experience.

 - Proficiency designing and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, and rate limiting.

 - Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues such as Kafka or Pub/Sub, and debugging complex state machines.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, data modeling, query optimization, SQL, and analytics tools.

 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and code review.

 - Experience developing consumer-facing products and working with distributed systems in a data-heavy environment.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals and experience in a high-bar engineering organization.

 - Go and GCP experience are valued.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $120,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
